newsitem.title: FINLAND: INCAP TO INVEST FIM 16 MLN IN PLANT.
newsitem.headline: INCAP TO INVEST FIM 16 MLN IN PLANT.

text.p: Finnish furniture and electronics group Incap Oy said on Friday that its Incap Furniture Oy unit would invest 16 million markka to expand its plant at Karsamaki.
"The estimated 16 million markka expansion investment project will be completed by the end of the year," Incap said in a statement.
Incap said the investment would be made to replace its plant at Ranua that was destroyed by fire in February, and that insurance would cover the fire damages.
"Insurance covers the damages arising from the fire, and the immediate effects of the fire are not expected to weaken the company's result for the current year," Incap said.
The 3,000 square metre expansion at the Karsamaki plant would house furniture production, surface treatment and packaging lines, it said.
